findings.reason: §2 collapses to adding write-path-vs-mention provenance to an existing renderer, and §8, which restates §2, is deleted outright.

findings.reason: §3's premise "today they cost the same [as full]" is false — a bare mention already costs zero — so the section scopes to the missing reference-cost constant, not a new extractor.

findings.reason: the section exists only because a literal grep missed the mechanism under a different name; verifying the mechanism removes §8.

findings.reason: §7 re-opens a design settled in `f6e41cc7d`/`dcb91f926` and reintroduces the plan-wide shared-directory merge conflict it was meant to avoid.

findings.text: the same counts; §5 adds a reduced-brief marker to the run/ledger record and names no existing run-record field it retires, merges or extends

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; §2/§4/§5/§8 extend existing functions in `routing.py` and `dispatch.py` rather than spreading a subsystem across shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §7 re-proposes a shared `docs/figures/<plan>/` grant rather than extending the per-node grant owner `reckon/crew/dispatch.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1470, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §4 adds a CLI option and a refusal family, and §5 adds a run-record field, neither naming what it retires or merges.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan re-proposes the dominant-term refusal and the mention/reference distinction that already exist in `reckon/crew/routing.py`, and §7's premise is already false at HEAD in `reckon/crew/dispatch.py`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §8 is a second reporting section over the estimator that §2 already covers and the refusal already renders; it does not justify why `_context_refusal_detail` cannot be extended.
